title: Missing heat transfer
statement:
A system does $[$w]$ J of work while its internal energy rises by $[$e]$ J. Calculate the heat transferred into the system.

[________]{a}

feedback.message: Rearrange to q=ΔE−w with negative w.

hints: Rearrange to q=ΔE−w with negative w.
solution: Use $\Delta E=q+w$ with signed work $-[$w]$ J. Therefore $q=[$e]+[$w]$ J.
